newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran, Iraq swap bodies of soldiers killed in war.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Iraq swap bodies of soldiers killed in war.

text.p: Iran and Iraq on Tuesday exchanged the remains of more than 130 soldiers killed during their 1980-88 war, state-run Tehran radio said.

It quoted Brigadier General Mirfeisal Baqerzadeh, head of Iran's committee for the missing in action, as saying the bodies of 60 Iranians were exchanged with the remains of 77 Iraqi soldiers at the southwestern Shalamcheh border post.

Both sides have swapped several hundreds of prisoners of war (POWs) and remains of soldiers. But the missing in action and the POWs are still among the thorniest issues hindering efforts to improve ties between the former foes.
Iran has said 5,000 to 10,000 prisoners are held by Iraq. Baghdad denies holding any Iranians and says more than 20,000 Iraqis are held by Iran.
